prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished desktop homepage visual concept for Ethan, a Chinese AI Agent developer's personal website. A full edge-to-edge 16:10 website screenshot concept, no browser chrome, no device frame, no contact sheet. It is a personal portfolio, with clearly readable navigation "文章" "项目" "关于" and name "ETHAN". Real content only: AI Agent 开发工程师; "把想法，变成会工作的系统。" Show the opening of a separate projects or writing section below the hero, proving the style extends beyond decorative art. No invented metrics, awards, clients, availability, or fake social proof. Chinese and English typography must be crisp. No unnecessary eyebrow labels, badges, large explanatory paragraphs, endless tiny labels, dashboard widgets, gradient text, generic equal card grids, or template copy-left/art-right split hero. The artifact must clearly read as a usable website. DIRECTION A — KINETIC TYPE LAB. Treat the actual webpage as an interactive typographic specimen and an uncompromising Swiss experimental poster brought to the web. Warm near-white ground, ink black typography, a single acidic yellow-green field. A huge typographic "ETHAN" spans the center horizontally in a beautifully custom expressive variable grotesk; its E and A have different width/weight as though responding to a pointer, but every letter remains legible. A thin outlined cursor position subtly distorts the baseline of the central lettering. Below the giant name, the Chinese one-line statement is large, direct, elegantly aligned with a small circular arrow control labeled "探索作品". Keep the author role small and well spaced. Navigation runs cleanly along the top with no secondary English labels. A large lime rectangle occupies one deliberate part of the composition, intersected by the letterform, never a blob. Lower fifth begins a precise black-on-white editorial index with two actual subject rows "Agent 系统" and "技术笔记", thin rules, no thumbnails required. The design should have architectural composition, memorable negative space, confident print-level type and a live-web affordance. This direction uses typography, not a 3D machine, as its sole dominant visual engine. Do not write a scheme name or the letter A anywhere in the UI.
